_note: This manifest covers two figures (F0a, F0b) emitted by a single script run. The hash chain on outputs is unchanged from the original single-figure_id manifest produced at git_sha a69846f7. See docs/mentor_review/01_dataset.md §3 Finding 5 for the rationale behind splitting figure_id into figure_ids/figures. The splits/manifest.json input pin is re-baselined to the current leakage-fixed (post-3cd2fb9) generation; that file embeds a non-deterministic `generated_at` timestamp so its SHA is machine-local and is re-pinned per regeneration. The split *content* is fully reproducible (seed 42, ratios 0.7/0.1/0.2): all 15 split-index output SHAs are internally consistent and OOD classes are leakage-free. data/processed/ is gitignored, so on a fresh clone this input is absent and the check SKIPs.
